_note: Default config of AnisotropicFKPPSolver: every parameter, the optional ones at the class defaults (tests/test_config.py checks that). Volumes are NIfTI paths relative to this file; rho and white_matter_diffusivity are the means of scripts/parameter_range.txt; the seed is the image center.
_volumes: diffusion_tensors (a (Nx, Ny, Nz, 3, 3) NIfTI) is null: no example tensor field ships with the repository yet, so this config does not run until one is given. The tissue maps are only needed with uniform_gray_matter.
